# SOP-P2-L3-04 Shift handover - Machining line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, EQ-P2-L3-IH03

Purpose
1. Provide a consistent, auditable handover for the Machining line between shifts to maintain continuity of production, safety, and equipment care.

Preconditions
2. Outgoing operator must complete end-of-shift checks and log all observations in the line log.  
3. Incoming operator must have reviewed this SOP and the related documents: ECN-2026-037, SOP-P2-L3-01, SOP-P2-L3-02.

PPE
4. Mandatory PPE for handover walkthrough: safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, and any task-specific respirator as required by SOP-P2-L3-01.

Handover checklist (to be covered verbally and signed)
5. Machine status: confirm operational readiness of EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, EQ-P2-L3-IH03. Report any interlocks, alarms, or pending work orders.  
6. Lubrication verification: record lubricant used for each machine. The lubricant part number for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is CFW-LUB-225. The lubricant part number for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is CFW-LUB-725. Confirm levels and any pending reorders per ECN-2026-037.  
7. Maintenance and defects: list any defects, temporary repairs, or scheduled maintenance noted. Reference SOP-P2-L3-02 for lockout/tagout procedures if maintenance is required.  
8. Work-in-progress: detail current batch, last good piece, scrap counts, and any quality flags. Use SOP-P2-L3-01 for quality acceptance criteria.  
9. Consumables and tooling: note tooling condition and next required changeover. Report shortages for procurement action.

Sign-off
10. Outgoing operator name and signature: ______________________  
11. Incoming operator name and signature: ______________________  
12. Supervisor verification (on duty) name and signature: ______________________

Records
13. Retain signed handover sheet in line log and scan to document control per ECN-2026-037.
